processing.cycle: Bounded same-support endpoint search; local C1 overlap crossfade using retained source handles. No full-cycle large root drift correction.
processing.root: Split horizontal p0 + phase * displacement + residual; preserve displacement as cycle distance and close only residual/vertical tracks.
processing.source_interpolation: Cubic Hermite interpolation of root residual and relative quaternion log vectors; reject log angles near pi. Blend rotations by shortest-arc slerp across the local seam window.
processing.toe: Measure terminal ball direction from weighted toe-cap vertices projected to the authored forefoot sole plane; use heel-to-forefoot centers for forward sign, not forefoot PCA's widest axis.
processing.target: Absolute segment bases preserve actual source directions; keep all target bone parents, positions/scales, geometry, materials and frozen rifle rest.
processing.runtime_candidate: After target bake and finite checks, drive opt-in development actors from resolved displacement with cached baked quaternions; do not run source parsing or whole-mesh foot scans each gameplay frame.
processing.runtime_interpolation: Cyclic Catmull-Rom target quaternion components, neighbor hemisphere correction and normalization; no duplicated endpoint in cyclic neighborhood. Validate seams using the actual consumer.
processing.phase_alignment: Run phase +0.5 relative to walk, applied to all bone and pelvis tracks before blending. Independent target-FK marker checks and actual controller blend captures; this is not shoe contact acceptance.

requirements: Preserve raw sources and earlier diagnostic evidence; register new candidates separately.
TDD for cycle seam value/velocity, preserved middle interval, root-motion separation, antipodal quaternion samples, branch/handle rejection and measured leaf directions.
Use central differences with real samples outside the selected interval; clearly distinguish intervals and inclusive samples.
Measure final target quaternion seam below 1e-5 rad and velocity mismatch below 1e-3 rad/s after contact corrections; never infer target seams solely from source curves.
Report per-bone maximum/RMS source correction, contact penetration/slip, reach refusal and all source/instance/hand invariants.
Inspect continuous playback across at least two cycles, transitions and real-game movement before runtime animation acceptance.
Benchmark five-actor gameplay under the same renderer/quality conditions; numerical or static checks alone do not prove acceptable FPS.
alpha_policy: Motion and geometry-derived calibration only; existing texture alpha and all image bytes unchanged.
